name: Overloaded: Thunderstrike
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Electro Dice and 2 Pyro Dice.
After each time the opponent switches characters: Deal 1 Piercing DMG to opponent's active character, then increase the Piercing DMG dealt by this card by 1 for this Round (up to 3).
